judgments.reason: No model articulation explains that the three-coin commission is applied to allow bids exceeding available coins, and no trace shows any bid above coins winning due to commission-included-before-payment.

The model queried the clerk for rival bids but did not articulate the specific timing mechanism claimed (that waiting reveals rivals before you commit your own bid). The focal player had already committed before clerk revelations, so the transcript does not demonstrate the stated pre-commit information advantage.

Settlement occurred while lots remained unsold, but the model did not articulate the mechanism that close can settle early; the playbook only requests settlement. Because the model failed to state the rule discrepancy as the mechanism, this is not a validated discovery.
There is no model articulation claiming that the three-coin auction commission is applied to catalog purchases, nor any evidence in the transcript that a catalog purchase received auction commission.
